en.headline: Financial Secretary hails China Government Bond Futures as key offshore RMB tool
en.dek: Paul Chan said the launch closes a critical gap in the offshore renminbi toolkit and strengthens Hong Kong’s role as a risk-management hub.
body: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said at the Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing launch ceremony for five-year China Government Bond Futures on Monday that the product closes a critical gap in the offshore renminbi toolkit.

Chan said the futures, together with Bond Connect and Swap Connect, give international investors greater access to the Chinese bond market and the confidence to build long-term holdings with adequate risk-management tools. He described the launch as an important step supporting the long-term development of the offshore renminbi bond market and the broader internationalisation of the renminbi.

The Financial Secretary noted that Hong Kong already has a stable offshore renminbi liquidity pool exceeding 1.1 trillion yuan, efficient settlement systems handling nearly 48 trillion yuan monthly, a growing dim-sum bond market, and the demonstration effect of sovereign renminbi bonds issued in the city.
He thanked the China Securities Regulatory Commission and central authorities for their support in bringing the product to market after a period of coordination and preparation.

zh.headline: 財政司司長：國債期貨補上離岸人民幣工具關鍵拼圖
zh.dek: 陳茂波在港交所五年期中國國債期貨上市儀式上表示，產品為離岸人民幣工具箱補上重要一環，強化香港風險管理中心角色。
body: 財政司司長陳茂波星期一在香港交易及結算所五年期中國國債期貨上市儀式上表示，該產品為離岸人民幣工具箱補上關鍵拼圖。
陳茂波指，國債期貨與債券通及利率互換通結合，讓國際投資者不但能更便利進入內地債券市場，亦能在具備充足風險管理工具的情況下建立長期持倉。他形容上市是支持離岸人民幣債券市場長遠發展及人民幣國際化的重要一步。
財政司司長指出，香港已具備穩定的離岸人民幣資金池（超過1.1萬億元人民幣）、高效的結算系統（每月處理接近48萬億元人民幣）、持續擴大的點心債市場，以及國家在港發行人民幣國債的示範效應。
他感謝中國證券監督管理委員會及中央相關部委在協調準備期間的大力支持，令產品得以推出。
